scripts.sync-monaco: rm -rf public/vs && mkdir -p public && cp -r node_modules/monaco-editor/min/vs public/vs
scripts.sync-skills: rm -rf src-tauri/.vtnexa/skills && mkdir -p src-tauri/.vtnexa/skills && cp .vtnexa/skills/*.md src-tauri/.vtnexa/skills/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.stage-sidecar: rm -rf src-tauri/sidecar-stage && mkdir -p src-tauri/sidecar-stage/browser && cp sidecar/browser/server.js sidecar/browser/package.json src-tauri/sidecar-stage/browser/ && cp -rL sidecar/browser/node_modules src-tauri/sidecar-stage/browser/node_modules
scripts.pretauri: pnpm run stage-sidecar && pnpm run sync-skills
scripts.prebuild: pnpm run sync-monaco && pnpm run sync-skills
